decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several functional backpacks across different price points. The SHENHU 40L (prod_backpacks_111) stood out as the best value, offering significant capacity and specialized hiking features for a very competitive price of $26.99. The W WINTMING tactical pack (prod_backpacks_164) was a strong contender but had a review mentioning a broken buckle, which raised durability concerns. The KAILAS (prod_backpacks_043) appeared to be a high-quality 'Osprey dupe' but was much more expensive at $69.99. The ZOMAKE and Mubasel options were good for lighter or more specific uses, but the SHENHU offered the most versatility for a general-purpose hiking daypack.
